title: Baby Deanna Joyce Woodward in Bassinet, 1937 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Deanna Joyce Woodward
Born Jan. 19th 1937
2 weeks old.

B285
description: A black and white vintage snapshot capturing two-week-old infant Deanna Joyce Woodward resting inside a woven hooded wicker bassinet. The back contains handwritten details confirming her name, birth date of January 19, 1937, and age of two weeks, placing the photograph in early February 1937.
